intro: Rêve display unit turns everyday essentials into a cheerful showcase. With its open shelves and clean silhouette, it encourages independence while keeping books and treasures beautifully organised.

features.title: Sleek silhouette for light visual balance
features.text: Clean lines and balanced proportions keep the Reve display unit visually light. Its simple geometry blends seamlessly into children’s rooms without overwhelming the space.

features.title: Open display shelves for easy access
features.text: Multiple open compartments make it easy for children to store and retrieve books, toys, and keepsakes. Reve’s open storage encourages independence and organisation.

features.title: Surface top for added storage flexibility
features.text: Reve’s flat-top surface offers additional space for décor, lamps, or display pieces. This extended usability enhances both function and styling options.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
